summary: Answered why only one attack order lands, and corrected the previous packet's premise. 00A2CBD0 replaces a group's command whenever the target differs, so the missing AI command object was never the blocker. The caps are the mode planner's first-owned-group rule and, in the host, a target set of one group. The second was caused by src/game_hosts_ai.cpp leaving 00A2E260's split a no-op; the split is implemented and measured.
ghidra_writes: none. Read-only analysis; one existing ledger name gained appended evidence.

The 009FE0A0 tail is PUSH 6, the ship base, alone. The plane base 0Fh is not admitted.

corrections.was: cc8_ai_coordinator_tick's report and doc: 'one attack order lands per mission and never a second, because the already-on-target test returns early and nothing clears the command without an AI command object'
corrections.is: The second clause is wrong. 00A2CBD0 deletes the old command and installs the new one whenever the target differs, so a different target lands a different order with no clear needed. The caps are (1) the mode planner ordering its first owned group only and (2) a target set of one group in the host.
corrections.how_found: Re-reading 00A2CBD0's transcribed body in docs/AI_PLANNERS.md against the packet's own claim.

corrections.was: src/game_hosts_ai.cpp split_detached_members: a no-op, on the reasoning that nothing in this process detaches a member
corrections.is: 00A2E260 does not split on detachment; it splits on 009FE080 and is the group multiplier. Implemented.
corrections.measured: IJN01 groups 2 to 4, splits_taken 0 to 2, planner claims 1 to 2.

corrections.measured: IJN01 commands issued 79 to 34, of which 30 artillery tokens and 4 dogfight.

validation.tests: ctest --test-dir build/win32 -C Release: 2/2 pass. No test added: the rules are exercised by the host on three missions and a unit test would mirror the implementation.

ijn01.attribution: The 45 orders that went away were inert: plane motion, the pilot attack table and the gunnery outcome are identical to the digit. The grouping is now faithful and nothing that was working stopped working. The order count did not move, which isolates the mode planner's first-owned-group rule as the remaining cap: two claims produced two owned groups and still one order.
ijn01.note: The fixed-step hook was applied locally to take this measurement and reverted before the commit. USN01 and USN02 were not re-run for this packet; the change is to grouping, and IJN01 is the mission with the mixed ship and aircraft population that exercises the split.

uncertainties: 007EDA90's three inputs have no producer in this process: nothing builds the squadron's +3D0h carrier link, its IsKindOf(17h) answer or the +C24h byte. The host leaves all three false, so it admits every squadron as groupable. Four of IJN01's units take that path; the other thirty of the commanded group are ship bases and do not depend on it.
00A13340, the command factory, is still unread. It matters for 00A2C8D0's merge predicate at vtable[+14h], not for the order count.
Whether a planner that owns several groups orders only the first natively too, or whether 00A179E0's engagement pass orders the rest. 00A179E0's body is unread.
USN01 and USN02 were not re-measured with the split.
